title: 1.5.0 hangs on the landing screen after an in-place update

summary: Root cause found: apply-update.cjs has no fromVersion precondition; 1.4.4->1.5.0 delta applied onto a 1.3.0 install.

reason: P0 hotfix: fromVersion guard + full 1.5.1 bundle + the install-test gate.
Release gate closed: install-test update leg rewritten (two-behind + real generation), checkUpdateEvidence added behind --publish, fromVersion documented in the distribution contract.
Five update-evidence fixtures exercised; the only release:check failure left is the pre-existing stale smoke evidence, which blocks the 1.5.0 re-cut.
